entries.label: Acid Arrow
entries.summary: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn.

values.name: Acid Arrow
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Acid Splash
entries.summary: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.

values.name: Acid Splash
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Aid
entries.summary: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration.

values.name: Aid
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Alarm
entries.summary: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area.

values.name: Alarm
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Alter Self
entries.summary: You assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the spell. While the spell lasts, you can end one option as an action to gain the benefits of a different one.

values.name: Alter Self
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Animal Friendship
entries.summary: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails.

values.name: Animal Friendship
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Animal Messenger
entries.summary: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat.

values.name: Animal Messenger
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Animal Shapes
entries.summary: Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower.

values.name: Animal Shapes
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Animate Dead
entries.summary: This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature.

values.name: Animate Dead
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 10 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Animate Objects
entries.summary: Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects. You can't animate any object larger than Huge.

values.name: Animate Objects
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Antilife Shell
entries.summary: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs. The barrier lasts for the duration. The barrier prevents an affected creature from passing or reaching through.

values.name: Antilife Shell
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Antimagic Field
entries.summary: A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic surrounds you. This area is divorced from the magical energy that suffuses the multiverse. Within the sphere, spells can't be cast, summoned creatures disappear, and even magic items become mundane.

values.name: Antimagic Field
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Antipathy/Sympathy
entries.summary: This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice. You target something within range, either a Huge or smaller object or creature or an area that is no larger than a 200-foot cube. Then specify a kind of intelligent creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires.

values.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 days. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Arcane Eye
entries.summary: You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which has normal vision and darkvision out to 30 feet. The eye can look in every direction.

values.name: Arcane Eye
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Arcane Hand
entries.summary: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the spell's duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand.

values.name: Arcane Hand
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Arcane Lock
entries.summary: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally.

values.name: Arcane Lock
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Arcane Sword
entries.summary: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 force damage.

values.name: Arcane Sword
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Arcanist's Magic Aura
entries.summary: You place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it. The target can be a willing creature or an object that isn't being carried or worn by another creature. When you cast the spell, choose one or both of the following effects.

values.name: Arcanist's Magic Aura
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Astral Projection
entries.summary: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you are already on that plane).

values.name: Astral Projection
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: 10 feet. Duration: special. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Augury
entries.summary: By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a specific course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes.

values.name: Augury
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Awaken
entries.summary: After spending the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, you touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant. The target must have either no Intelligence score or an Intelligence of 3 or less. The target gains an Intelligence of 10.

values.name: Awaken
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: 8 hours. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Bane
entries.summary: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make charisma saving throws.

values.name: Bane
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Banishment
entries.summary: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a charisma saving throw or be banished. If the target is native to the plane of existence you're on, you banish the target to a harmless demiplane.

values.name: Banishment
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Barkskin
entries.summary: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target's AC can't be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.

values.name: Barkskin
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Beacon of Hope
entries.summary: This spell bestows hope and vitality. Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has advantage on wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

values.name: Beacon of Hope
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Bestow Curse
entries.summary: You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. When you cast this spell, choose the nature of the curse from the following options: - Choose one ability score.

values.name: Bestow Curse
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Black Tentacles
entries.summary: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. For the duration, these tentacles turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

values.name: Black Tentacles
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Blade Barrier
entries.summary: You create a vertical wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You can make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick.

values.name: Blade Barrier
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Bless
entries.summary: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

values.name: Bless
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Blight
entries.summary: Necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it. The target must make a constitution saving throw. The target takes 8d8 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

values.name: Blight
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Blindness/Deafness
entries.summary: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a constitution saving throw.

values.name: Blindness/Deafness
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V.

entries.label: Blink
entries.summary: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell. On a roll of 11 or higher, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you were already on that plane).

values.name: Blink
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Blur
entries.summary: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

values.name: Blur
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V.

entries.label: Branding Smite
entries.summary: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike.

values.name: Branding Smite
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V.

entries.label: Burning Hands
entries.summary: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

values.name: Burning Hands
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Call Lightning
entries.summary: A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see 100 feet directly above you.

values.name: Call Lightning
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Calm Emotions
entries.summary: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes.

values.name: Calm Emotions
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Chain Lightning
entries.summary: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target.

values.name: Chain Lightning
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Charm Person
entries.summary: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it.

values.name: Charm Person
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Chill Touch
entries.summary: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature to assail it with the chill of the grave. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

values.name: Chill Touch
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 round. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Circle of Death
entries.summary: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range. Each creature in that area must make a constitution saving throw. A target takes 8d6 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

values.name: Circle of Death
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Clairvoyance
entries.summary: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees).

values.name: Clairvoyance
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: 1 mile. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Clone
entries.summary: This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death. This clone forms inside a sealed vessel and grows to full size and maturity after 120 days; you can also choose to have the clone be a younger version of the same creature.

values.name: Clone
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Cloudkill
entries.summary: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the fog, ending the spell. Its area is heavily obscured.

values.name: Cloudkill
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Color Spray
entries.summary: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. Roll 6d10; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can effect.

values.name: Color Spray
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 round. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Command
entries.summary: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it.

values.name: Command
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 round. Components: V.

entries.label: Commune
entries.summary: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.

values.name: Commune
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Commune with Nature
entries.summary: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet.

values.name: Commune with Nature
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Comprehend Languages
entries.summary: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text.

values.name: Comprehend Languages
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Compulsion
entries.summary: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be charmed. On a failed save, a target is affected by this spell.

values.name: Compulsion
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Cone of Cold
entries.summary: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a constitution saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

values.name: Cone of Cold
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Confusion
entries.summary: This spell assaults and twists creatures' minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action. Each creature in a 10 foot radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw when you cast this spell or be affected by it.

values.name: Confusion
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Conjure Animals
entries.summary: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

values.name: Conjure Animals
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Conjure Celestial
entries.summary: You summon a celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The celestial disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The celestial is friendly to you and your companions for the duration.

values.name: Conjure Celestial
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Conjure Elemental
entries.summary: You call forth an elemental servant. Choose an area of air, earth, fire, or water that fills a 10-foot cube within range. An elemental of challenge rating 5 or lower appropriate to the area you chose appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it.

values.name: Conjure Elemental
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Conjure Fey
entries.summary: You summon a fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower, or a fey spirit that takes the form of a beast of challenge rating 6 or lower. It appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The fey creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

values.name: Conjure Fey
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Conjure Minor Elementals
entries.summary: You summon elementals that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

values.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Conjure Woodland Beings
entries.summary: You summon fey creatures that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

values.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Contact Other Plane
entries.summary: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other mysterious entity from another plane. Contacting this extraplanar intelligence can strain or even break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 intelligence saving throw.

values.name: Contact Other Plane
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V.

entries.label: Contagion
entries.summary: Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice from any of the ones described below. At the end of each of the target's turns, it must make a constitution saving throw.

values.name: Contagion
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 7 days. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Contingency
entries.summary: Choose a spell of 5th level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of 1 action, and that can target you. You cast that spell-called the contingent spell-as part of casting contingency, expending spell slots for both, but the contingent spell doesn't come into effect.

values.name: Contingency
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: Self. Duration: 10 days. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Continual Flame
entries.summary: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

values.name: Continual Flame
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Control Water
entries.summary: Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side. You can choose from any of the following effects when you cast this spell. As an action on your turn, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

values.name: Control Water
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 300 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Control Weather
entries.summary: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. Moving to a place where you don't have a clear path to the sky ends the spell early.

values.name: Control Weather
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: Self. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Counterspell
entries.summary: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability.

values.name: Counterspell
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: reaction. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: S.

entries.label: Create Food and Water
entries.summary: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food is bland but nourishing, and spoils if uneaten after 24 hours. The water is clean and doesn't go bad.

values.name: Create Food and Water
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Create or Destroy Water
entries.summary: You either create or destroy water. **Create Water.** You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot cube within range **Destroy Water.** You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range.

values.name: Create or Destroy Water
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Create Undead
entries.summary: You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small humanoids within range. Each corpse becomes a ghoul under your control.

values.name: Create Undead
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 10 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Creation
entries.summary: You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create a nonliving object of vegetable matter within 'range': soft goods, rope, wood, or something similar. You can also use this spell to create mineral objects such as stone, crystal, or metal.

values.name: Creation
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 30 feet. Duration: special. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Cure Wounds
entries.summary: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

values.name: Cure Wounds
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Dancing Lights
entries.summary: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing vaguely humanoid form of Medium size.

values.name: Dancing Lights
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Darkness
entries.summary: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

values.name: Darkness
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, M.

entries.label: Darkvision
entries.summary: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

values.name: Darkvision
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Daylight
entries.summary: A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it.

values.name: Daylight
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Death Ward
entries.summary: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends.

values.name: Death Ward
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Delayed Blast Fireball
entries.summary: A beam of yellow light flashes from your pointing finger, then condenses to linger at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration.

values.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Demiplane
entries.summary: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door is large enough to allow Medium creatures to pass through unhindered. When opened, the door leads to a demiplane that appears to be an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone.

values.name: Demiplane
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: S.

entries.label: Detect Evil and Good
entries.summary: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located. Similarly, you know if there is a place or object within 30 feet of you that has been magically consecrated or desecrated.

values.name: Detect Evil and Good
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Detect Magic
entries.summary: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any.

values.name: Detect Magic
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Detect Poison and Disease
entries.summary: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case.

values.name: Detect Poison and Disease
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Detect Thoughts
entries.summary: For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures. When you cast the spell and as your action on each turn until the spell ends, you can focus your mind on any one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you.

values.name: Detect Thoughts
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Dimension Door
entries.summary: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired.

values.name: Dimension Door
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 500 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Disguise Self
entries.summary: You make yourself - including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person - look different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between.

values.name: Disguise Self
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Disintegrate
entries.summary: A thin green ray springs from your pointing finger to a target that you can see within range. The target can be a creature, an object, or a creation of magical force, such as the wall created by wall of force. A creature targeted by this spell must make a dexterity saving throw.

values.name: Disintegrate
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Dispel Evil and Good
entries.summary: Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, undead, and creatures originating from beyond the Material Plane. For the duration, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

values.name: Dispel Evil and Good
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Dispel Magic
entries.summary: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

values.name: Dispel Magic
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Divination
entries.summary: Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply. The reply might be a short phrase, a cryptic rhyme, or an omen.

values.name: Divination
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Divine Favor
entries.summary: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

values.name: Divine Favor
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Divine Word
entries.summary: You utter a divine word, imbued with the power that shaped the world at the dawn of creation. Choose any number of creatures you can see within range. Each creature that can hear you must make a Charisma saving throw.

values.name: Divine Word
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Dominate Beast
entries.summary: You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

values.name: Dominate Beast
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Dominate Monster
entries.summary: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

values.name: Dominate Monster
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Dominate Person
entries.summary: You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

values.name: Dominate Person
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Dream
entries.summary: This spell shapes a creature's dreams. Choose a creature known to you as the target of this spell. The target must be on the same plane of existence as you. Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, can't be contacted by this spell.

values.name: Dream
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Special. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Druidcraft
entries.summary: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range: - You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours.

values.name: Druidcraft
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Earthquake
entries.summary: You create a seismic disturbance at a point on the ground that you can see within range. For the duration, an intense tremor rips through the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle centered on that point and shakes creatures and structures in contact with the ground in that area.

values.name: Earthquake
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 500 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Eldritch Blast
entries.summary: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.

values.name: Eldritch Blast
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Enhance Ability
entries.summary: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends. **Bear's Endurance.** The target has advantage on constitution checks. It also gains 2d6 temporary hit points, which are lost when the spell ends.

values.name: Enhance Ability
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Enlarge/Reduce
entries.summary: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration. Choose either a creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried. If the target is unwilling, it can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell has no effect.

values.name: Enlarge/Reduce
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Entangle
entries.summary: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting form a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

values.name: Entangle
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Enthrall
entries.summary: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you to make a wisdom saving throw.

values.name: Enthrall
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Etherealness
entries.summary: You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration or until you use your action to dismiss the spell. During this time, you can move in any direction.

values.name: Etherealness
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Expeditious Retreat
entries.summary: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action.

values.name: Expeditious Retreat
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Eyebite
entries.summary: For the spell's duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration.

values.name: Eyebite
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Fabricate
entries.summary: You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, and clothes from flax or wool. Choose raw materials that you can see within range.

values.name: Fabricate
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: 120 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Faerie Fire
entries.summary: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Any creature in the area when the spell is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed dim light in a 10-foot radius.

values.name: Faerie Fire
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V.

entries.label: Faithful Hound
entries.summary: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it. The hound is invisible to all creatures except you and can't be harmed.

values.name: Faithful Hound
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: False Life
entries.summary: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

values.name: False Life
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Fear
entries.summary: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for the duration.

values.name: Fear
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Feather Fall
entries.summary: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet, and the spell ends for that creature.

values.name: Feather Fall
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: reaction. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, M.

entries.label: Feeblemind
entries.summary: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality. The target takes 4d6 psychic damage and must make an intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1.

values.name: Feeblemind
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Find Familiar
entries.summary: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog (toad), hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish (quipper), rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.

values.name: Find Familiar
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: 10 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Find Steed
entries.summary: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong, and loyal steed, creating a long-lasting bond with it. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the steed takes on a form that you choose, such as a warhorse, a pony, a camel, an elk, or a mastiff.

values.name: Find Steed
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Find the Path
entries.summary: This spell allows you to find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific fixed location that you are familiar with on the same plane of existence.

values.name: Find the Path
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Self. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Find Traps
entries.summary: You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight. A trap, for the purpose of this spell, includes anything that would inflict a sudden or unexpected effect you consider harmful or undesirable, which was specifically intended as such by its creator.

values.name: Find Traps
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Finger of Death
entries.summary: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain. The target must make a constitution saving throw. It takes 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

values.name: Finger of Death
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Fire Bolt
entries.summary: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

values.name: Fire Bolt
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Fire Shield
entries.summary: Thin and vaporous flame surround your body for the duration of the spell, radiating a bright light bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can end the spell using an action to make it disappear. The flames are around you a heat shield or cold, your choice.

values.name: Fire Shield
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Fire Storm
entries.summary: A storm made up of sheets of roaring flame appears in a location you choose within range. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish. Each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube.

values.name: Fire Storm
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Fireball
entries.summary: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a dexterity saving throw.

values.name: Fireball
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Flame Blade
entries.summary: You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar, and it lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke the blade again as a bonus action. You can use your action to make a melee spell attack with the fiery blade.

values.name: Flame Blade
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Flame Strike
entries.summary: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a dexterity saving throw.

values.name: Flame Strike
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Flaming Sphere
entries.summary: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a dexterity saving throw.

values.name: Flaming Sphere
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Flesh to Stone
entries.summary: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into stone. If the target's body is made of flesh, the creature must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained as its flesh begins to harden. On a successful save, the creature isn't affected.

values.name: Flesh to Stone
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Floating Disk
entries.summary: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The disk remains for the duration, and can hold up to 500 pounds.

values.name: Floating Disk
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Fly
entries.summary: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.

values.name: Fly
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Fog Cloud
entries.summary: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

values.name: Fog Cloud
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Forbiddance
entries.summary: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet above the floor. For the duration, creatures can't teleport into the area or use portals, such as those created by the gate spell, to enter the area.

values.name: Forbiddance
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: Touch. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Forcecage
entries.summary: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose.

values.name: Forcecage
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 100 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Foresight
entries.summary: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can't be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

values.name: Foresight
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Touch. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Freedom of Movement
entries.summary: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained.

values.name: Freedom of Movement
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Freezing Sphere
entries.summary: A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your fingertips to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature within the area must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d6 cold damage.

values.name: Freezing Sphere
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 300 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Gaseous Form
entries.summary: You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends if the creature drops to 0 hit points. An incorporeal creature isn't affected.

values.name: Gaseous Form
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Gate
entries.summary: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. The portal lasts for the duration.

values.name: Gate
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Geas
entries.summary: You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide. If the creature can understand you, it must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration.

values.name: Geas
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 30 days. Components: V.

entries.label: Gentle Repose
entries.summary: You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can't become undead.

values.name: Gentle Repose
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 10 days. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Giant Insect
entries.summary: You transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into giant versions of their natural forms for the duration. A centipede becomes a giant centipede, a spider becomes a giant spider, a wasp becomes a giant wasp, and a scorpion becomes a giant scorpion.

values.name: Giant Insect
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Glibness
entries.summary: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates that you are being truthful.

values.name: Glibness
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V.

entries.label: Globe of Invulnerability
entries.summary: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you and remains for the duration. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it, even if the spell is cast using a higher level spell slot.

values.name: Globe of Invulnerability
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Glyph of Warding
entries.summary: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that harms other creatures, either upon a surface (such as a table or a section of floor or wall) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest) to conceal the glyph.

values.name: Glyph of Warding
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: Touch. Duration: until dispelled or triggered. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Goodberry
entries.summary: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

values.name: Goodberry
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Grease
entries.summary: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration. When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

values.name: Grease
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Greater Invisibility
entries.summary: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.

values.name: Greater Invisibility
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Greater Restoration
entries.summary: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect.

values.name: Greater Restoration
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Guardian of Faith
entries.summary: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity.

values.name: Guardian of Faith
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V.

entries.label: Guards and Wards
entries.summary: You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (an area 50 feet square, or one hundred 5-foot squares or twenty-five 10-foot squares). The warded area can be up to 20 feet tall, and shaped as you desire.

values.name: Guards and Wards
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: Touch. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Guidance
entries.summary: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

values.name: Guidance
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Guiding Bolt
entries.summary: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target.

values.name: Guiding Bolt
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 round. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Gust of Wind
entries.summary: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the line.

values.name: Gust of Wind
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Hallow
entries.summary: You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power. The area can have a radius up to 60 feet, and the spell fails if the radius includes an area already under the effect a hallow spell. The affected area is subject to the following effects.

values.name: Hallow
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: 24 hours. Range: Touch. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Hallucinatory Terrain
entries.summary: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain.

values.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: 300 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Harm
entries.summary: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14d6 necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. The damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

values.name: Harm
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Haste
entries.summary: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns.

values.name: Haste
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Heal
entries.summary: Choose a creature that you can see within range. A surge of positive energy washes through the creature, causing it to regain 70 hit points. This spell also ends blindness, deafness, and any diseases affecting the target. This spell has no effect on constructs or undead.

values.name: Heal
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Healing Word
entries.summary: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

values.name: Healing Word
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Heat Metal
entries.summary: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell.

values.name: Heat Metal
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Hellish Rebuke
entries.summary: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 2d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

values.name: Hellish Rebuke
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: reaction. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Heroes' Feast
entries.summary: You bring forth a great feast, including magnificent food and drink. The feast takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don't set in until this hour is over. Up to twelve other creatures can partake of the feast.

values.name: Heroes' Feast
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Heroism
entries.summary: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns.

values.name: Heroism
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Hideous Laughter
entries.summary: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration.

values.name: Hideous Laughter
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Hold Monster
entries.summary: Choose a creature you can see within range. The target must make a saving throw of Wisdom or be paralyzed for the duration of the spell. This spell has no effect against the undead. At the end of each round, the target can make a new saving throw of Wisdom.

values.name: Hold Monster
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Hold Person
entries.summary: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

values.name: Hold Person
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Holy Aura
entries.summary: Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot radius around you.

values.name: Holy Aura
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Hunter's Mark
entries.summary: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check you make to find it.

values.name: Hunter's Mark
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: bonus action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V.

entries.label: Hypnotic Pattern
entries.summary: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration.

values.name: Hypnotic Pattern
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: S, M.

entries.label: Ice Storm
entries.summary: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the cylinder must make a dexterity saving throw.

values.name: Ice Storm
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 300 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Identify
entries.summary: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement to use, and how many charges it has, if any.

values.name: Identify
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Illusory Script
entries.summary: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration.

values.name: Illusory Script
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Touch. Duration: 10 days. Components: S, M.

entries.label: Imprisonment
entries.summary: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be bound by the spell; if it succeeds, it is immune to this spell if you cast it again.

values.name: Imprisonment
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 30 feet. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Incendiary Cloud
entries.summary: A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is heavily obscured.

values.name: Incendiary Cloud
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Inflict Wounds
entries.summary: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.

values.name: Inflict Wounds
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Insect Plague
entries.summary: Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The sphere spreads around corners. The sphere remains for the duration, and its area is lightly obscured. The sphere's area is difficult terrain.

values.name: Insect Plague
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 300 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Instant Summons
entries.summary: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less. The spell leaves an invisible mark on its surface and invisibly inscribes the name of the item on the sapphire you use as the material component.

values.name: Instant Summons
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Touch. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Invisibility
entries.summary: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

values.name: Invisibility
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Irresistible Dance
entries.summary: Choose one creature that you can see within range. The target begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping its feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this spell.

values.name: Irresistible Dance
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V.

entries.label: Jump
entries.summary: You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

values.name: Jump
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Knock
entries.summary: Choose an object that you can see within range. The object can be a door, a box, a chest, a set of manacles, a padlock, or another object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access.

values.name: Knock
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Legend Lore
entries.summary: Name or describe a person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about the thing you named. The lore might consist of current tales, forgotten stories, or even secret lore that has never been widely known.

values.name: Legend Lore
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Lesser Restoration
entries.summary: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

values.name: Lesser Restoration
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Levitate
entries.summary: One creature or object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate a target that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a constitution saving throw is unaffected.

values.name: Levitate
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Light
entries.summary: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light.

values.name: Light
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, M.

entries.label: Lightning Bolt
entries.summary: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

values.name: Lightning Bolt
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Locate Animals or Plants
entries.summary: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. Concentrating on the voice of nature in your surroundings, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.

values.name: Locate Animals or Plants
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Locate Creature
entries.summary: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement.

values.name: Locate Creature
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Locate Object
entries.summary: Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.

values.name: Locate Object
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Longstrider
entries.summary: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

values.name: Longstrider
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Mage Armor
entries.summary: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

values.name: Mage Armor
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Mage Hand
entries.summary: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again. You can use your action to control the hand.

values.name: Mage Hand
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Magic Circle
entries.summary: You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Glowing runes appear wherever the cylinder intersects with the floor or other surface.

values.name: Magic Circle
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 10 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Magic Jar
entries.summary: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the spell's material component. While your soul inhabits the container, you are aware of your surroundings as if you were in the container's space. You can't move or use reactions.

values.name: Magic Jar
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Self. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Magic Missile
entries.summary: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

values.name: Magic Missile
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Magic Mouth
entries.summary: You implant a message within an object in range, a message that is uttered when a trigger condition is met. Choose an object that you can see and that isn't being worn or carried by another creature.

values.name: Magic Mouth
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 30 feet. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Magic Weapon
entries.summary: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

values.name: Magic Weapon
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Magnificent Mansion
entries.summary: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration. You choose where its one entrance is located. The entrance shimmers faintly and is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall.

values.name: Magnificent Mansion
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 300 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Major Image
entries.summary: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration.

values.name: Major Image
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Mass Cure Wounds
entries.summary: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each target regains hit points equal to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
