values.name: Mass Cure Wounds
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Mass Heal
entries.summary: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range.

values.name: Mass Heal
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Mass Healing Word
entries.summary: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

values.name: Mass Healing Word
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Mass Suggestion
entries.summary: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect.

values.name: Mass Suggestion
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, M.

entries.label: Maze
entries.summary: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze. The target can use its action to attempt to escape. When it does so, it makes a DC 20 Intelligence check.

values.name: Maze
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Meld into Stone
entries.summary: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration. Using your movement, you step into the stone at a point you can touch.

values.name: Meld into Stone
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Mending
entries.summary: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no longer than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.

values.name: Mending
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Message
entries.summary: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear. You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier.

values.name: Message
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 round. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Meteor Swarm
entries.summary: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners.

values.name: Meteor Swarm
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 1 mile. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Mind Blank
entries.summary: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition.

values.name: Mind Blank
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Minor Illusion
entries.summary: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream.

values.name: Minor Illusion
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: S, M.

entries.label: Mirage Arcane
entries.summary: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. The terrain's general shape remains the same, however. Open fields or a road could be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain.

values.name: Mirage Arcane
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: Sight. Duration: 10 days. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Mirror Image
entries.summary: Three illusionary duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates.

values.name: Mirror Image
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Mislead
entries.summary: You become invisible at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.

values.name: Mislead
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: S.

entries.label: Misty Step
entries.summary: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

values.name: Misty Step
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: bonus action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Modify Memory
entries.summary: You attempt to reshape another creature's memories. One creature that you can see must make a wisdom saving throw. If you are fighting the creature, it has advantage on the saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes charmed by you for the duration.

values.name: Modify Memory
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Moonbeam
entries.summary: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, dim light fills the cylinder.

values.name: Moonbeam
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Move Earth
entries.summary: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area's elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar.

values.name: Move Earth
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 2 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Nondetection
entries.summary: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic. The target can be a willing creature or a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

values.name: Nondetection
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Pass without Trace
entries.summary: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by magical means.

values.name: Pass without Trace
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Passwall
entries.summary: A passage appears at a point of your choice that you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, a ceiling, or a floor) within range, and lasts for the duration. You choose the opening's dimensions: up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep.

values.name: Passwall
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Phantasmal Killer
entries.summary: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target must make a wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes frightened for the duration.

values.name: Phantasmal Killer
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Phantom Steed
entries.summary: A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. You decide the creature's appearance, but it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle.

values.name: Phantom Steed
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Planar Ally
entries.summary: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid. The being must be known to you: a god, a primordial, a demon prince, or some other being of cosmic power. That entity sends a celestial, an elemental, or a fiend loyal to it to aid you, making the creature appear in an unoccupied space within range.

values.name: Planar Ally
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Planar Binding
entries.summary: With this spell, you attempt to bind a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend to your service. The creature must be within range for the entire casting of the spell.

values.name: Planar Binding
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Plane Shift
entries.summary: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence.

values.name: Plane Shift
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Plant Growth
entries.summary: This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area. There are two possible uses for the spell, granting either immediate or long-term benefits. If you cast this spell using 1 action, choose a point within range.

values.name: Plant Growth
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Poison Spray
entries.summary: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage.

values.name: Poison Spray
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 10 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Polymorph
entries.summary: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. A shapechanger automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

values.name: Polymorph
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Power Word Kill
entries.summary: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the creature you choose has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

values.name: Power Word Kill
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Power Word Stun
entries.summary: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

values.name: Power Word Stun
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Prayer of Healing
entries.summary: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

values.name: Prayer of Healing
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Prestidigitation
entries.summary: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice. You create one of the following magical effects within 'range': - You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

values.name: Prestidigitation
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 10 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Prismatic Spray
entries.summary: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll a d8 to determine which color ray affects it. **1.

values.name: Prismatic Spray
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Prismatic Wall
entries.summary: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall-up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick-centered on a point you can see within range. Alternatively, you can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point you choose within range.

values.name: Prismatic Wall
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Private Sanctum
entries.summary: You make an area within range magically secure. The area is a cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. The spell lasts for the duration or until you use an action to dismiss it.

values.name: Private Sanctum
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Produce Flame
entries.summary: A flickering flame appears in your hand. The flame remains there for the duration and harms neither you nor your equipment. The flame sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The spell ends if you dismiss it as an action or if you cast it again.

values.name: Produce Flame
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Programmed Illusion
entries.summary: You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific condition occurs. The illusion is imperceptible until then.

values.name: Programmed Illusion
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Project Image
entries.summary: You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. The copy can appear at any location within range that you have seen before, regardless of intervening obstacles. The illusion looks and sounds like you but is intangible.

values.name: Project Image
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 500 miles. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Protection from Energy
entries.summary: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

values.name: Protection from Energy
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Protection from Evil and Good
entries.summary: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.

values.name: Protection from Evil and Good
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Protection from Poison
entries.summary: You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. If more than one poison afflicts the target, you neutralize one poison that you know is present, or you neutralize one at random.

values.name: Protection from Poison
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Purify Food and Drink
entries.summary: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

values.name: Purify Food and Drink
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 10 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Raise Dead
entries.summary: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days. If the creature's soul is both willing and at liberty to rejoin the body, the creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

values.name: Raise Dead
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Ray of Enfeeblement
entries.summary: A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends.

values.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Ray of Frost
entries.summary: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

values.name: Ray of Frost
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Regenerate
entries.summary: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains 4d8 + 15 hit points. For the duration of the spell, the target regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns (10 hit points each minute).

values.name: Regenerate
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Reincarnate
entries.summary: You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid. Provided that the creature has been dead no longer than 10 days, the spell forms a new adult body for it and then calls the soul to enter that body. If the target's soul isn't free or willing to do so, the spell fails.

values.name: Reincarnate
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Remove Curse
entries.summary: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

values.name: Remove Curse
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Resilient Sphere
entries.summary: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is enclosed for the duration.

values.name: Resilient Sphere
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Resistance
entries.summary: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The spell then ends.

values.name: Resistance
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Resurrection
entries.summary: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't undead. If its soul is free and willing, the target returns to life with all its hit points.

values.name: Resurrection
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Reverse Gravity
entries.summary: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot high cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall upward and reach the top of the area when you cast this spell.

values.name: Reverse Gravity
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 100 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Revivify
entries.summary: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

values.name: Revivify
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Rope Trick
entries.summary: You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope then rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground. At the upper end of the rope, an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends.

values.name: Rope Trick
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Sacred Flame
entries.summary: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

values.name: Sacred Flame
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Sanctuary
entries.summary: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.

values.name: Sanctuary
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: bonus action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Scorching Ray
entries.summary: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage.

values.name: Scorching Ray
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Scrying
entries.summary: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a wisdom saving throw, which is modified by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it.

values.name: Scrying
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: 10 minutes. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Secret Chest
entries.summary: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane. You must touch the chest and the miniature replica that serves as a material component for the spell. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet).

values.name: Secret Chest
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: See Invisibility
entries.summary: For the duration of the spell, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see through Ethereal. The ethereal objects and creatures appear ghostly translucent.

values.name: See Invisibility
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Seeming
entries.summary: This spell allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range. You give each target you choose a new, illusory appearance. An unwilling target can make a charisma saving throw, and if it succeeds, it is unaffected by this spell.

values.name: Seeming
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Sending
entries.summary: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. The creature hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately.

values.name: Sending
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Unlimited. Duration: 1 round. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Sequester
entries.summary: By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object can be hidden away, safe from detection for the duration. When you cast the spell and touch the target, it becomes invisible and can't be targeted by divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors created by divination spells.

values.name: Sequester
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Shapechange
entries.summary: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be of any creature with a challenge rating equal to your level or lower. The creature can't be a construct or an undead, and you must have seen the sort of creature at least once.

values.name: Shapechange
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Shatter
entries.summary: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-­--foot-­--radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw.

values.name: Shatter
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Shield
entries.summary: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

values.name: Shield
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: reaction. Range: Self. Duration: 1 round. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Shield of Faith
entries.summary: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

values.name: Shield of Faith
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: bonus action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Shillelagh
entries.summary: The wood of a club or a quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8.

values.name: Shillelagh
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Shocking Grasp
entries.summary: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal.

values.name: Shocking Grasp
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Silence
entries.summary: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it.

values.name: Silence
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Silent Image
entries.summary: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration. The image is purely visual; it isn't accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects.

values.name: Silent Image
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Simulacrum
entries.summary: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the spell. The duplicate is a creature, partially real and formed from ice or snow, and it can take actions and otherwise be affected as a normal creature.

values.name: Simulacrum
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: 12 hours. Range: Touch. Duration: until dispelled. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Sleep
entries.summary: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring unconscious creatures).

values.name: Sleep
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Sleet Storm
entries.summary: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. The area is heavily obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused. The ground in the area is covered with slick ice, making it difficult terrain.

values.name: Sleet Storm
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Slow
entries.summary: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range. Each target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration.

values.name: Slow
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Spare the Dying
entries.summary: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

values.name: Spare the Dying
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Speak with Animals
entries.summary: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

values.name: Speak with Animals
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Speak with Dead
entries.summary: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse must still have a mouth and can't be undead. The spell fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the last 10 days.

values.name: Speak with Dead
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 10 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Speak with Plants
entries.summary: You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands.

values.name: Speak with Plants
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Spider Climb
entries.summary: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.

values.name: Spider Climb
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Spike Growth
entries.summary: The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes difficult terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

values.name: Spike Growth
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Spirit Guardians
entries.summary: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice). If you are evil, they appear fiendish.

values.name: Spirit Guardians
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Spiritual Weapon
entries.summary: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon.

values.name: Spiritual Weapon
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: bonus action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Stinking Cloud
entries.summary: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration.

values.name: Stinking Cloud
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 90 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Stone Shape
entries.summary: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose.

values.name: Stone Shape
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Stoneskin
entries.summary: This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

values.name: Stoneskin
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Storm of Vengeance
entries.summary: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes in the area, thunder booms, and strong winds roar. Each creature under the cloud (no more than 5,000 feet beneath the cloud) when it appears must make a constitution saving throw.

values.name: Storm of Vengeance
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Sight. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Suggestion
entries.summary: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect.

values.name: Suggestion
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, M.

entries.label: Sunbeam
entries.summary: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d8 radiant damage and is blinded until your next turn.

values.name: Sunbeam
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Sunburst
entries.summary: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that light must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 12d6 radiant damage and is blinded for 1 minute.

values.name: Sunburst
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 150 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Symbol
entries.summary: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor, a wall, or a table) or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest).

values.name: Symbol
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Touch. Duration: until dispelled or triggered. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Telekinesis
entries.summary: You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell, and as your action each round for the duration, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below.

values.name: Telekinesis
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Telepathic Bond
entries.summary: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration. Creatures with Intelligence scores of 2 or less aren't affected by this spell.

values.name: Telepathic Bond
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Teleport
entries.summary: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.

values.name: Teleport
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 10 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Teleportation Circle
entries.summary: As you cast the spell, you draw a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you.

values.name: Teleportation Circle
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 10 feet. Duration: 1 round. Components: V, M.

entries.label: Thaumaturgy
entries.summary: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range. You create one of the following magical effects within range. - Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. - You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.

values.name: Thaumaturgy
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V.

entries.label: Thunderwave
entries.summary: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.

values.name: Thunderwave
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Time Stop
entries.summary: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.

values.name: Time Stop
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Tiny Hut
entries.summary: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area. Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome with you.

values.name: Tiny Hut
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: Self. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Tongues
entries.summary: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

values.name: Tongues
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, M.

entries.label: Transport via Plants
entries.summary: This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination plant at least once before.

values.name: Transport via Plants
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 10 feet. Duration: 1 round. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Tree Stride
entries.summary: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree.

values.name: Tree Stride
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: True Polymorph
entries.summary: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. You transform the creature into a different creature, the creature into an object, or the object into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried by another creature).

values.name: True Polymorph
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: True Resurrection
entries.summary: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. If the creature's soul is free and willing, the creature is restored to life with all its hit points.

values.name: True Resurrection
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: 1 hour. Range: Touch. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: True Seeing
entries.summary: This spell gives the willing creature you touch the ability to see things as they actually are. For the duration, the creature has truesight, notices secret doors hidden by magic, and can see into the Ethereal Plane, all out to a range of 120 feet.

values.name: True Seeing
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: True Strike
entries.summary: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this spell hasn't ended.

values.name: True Strike
values.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 round. Components: S.

entries.label: Unseen Servant
entries.summary: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, and a Strength of 2, and it can't attack.

values.name: Unseen Servant
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Vampiric Touch
entries.summary: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others to heal your wounds. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

values.name: Vampiric Touch
values.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Vicious Mockery
entries.summary: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range.

values.name: Vicious Mockery
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Wall of Fire
entries.summary: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.

values.name: Wall of Fire
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Wall of Force
entries.summary: An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface.

values.name: Wall of Force
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Wall of Ice
entries.summary: You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel.

values.name: Wall of Ice
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Wall of Stone
entries.summary: A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with at least one other panel.

values.name: Wall of Stone
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Wall of Thorns
entries.summary: You create a wall of tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration.

values.name: Wall of Thorns
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Warding Bond
entries.summary: This spell wards a willing creature you touch and creates a mystic connection between you and the target until the spell ends. While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has resistance to all damage.

values.name: Warding Bond
values.notes: Abjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Water Breathing
entries.summary: This spell gives a maximum of ten willing creatures within range and you can see, the ability to breathe underwater until the end of its term. Affected creatures also retain their normal breathing pattern.

values.name: Water Breathing
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Water Walk
entries.summary: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface-such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava-as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat).

values.name: Water Walk
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Web
entries.summary: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point for the duration. The webs are difficult terrain and lightly obscure their area.

values.name: Web
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Weird
entries.summary: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range must make a wisdom saving throw.

values.name: Weird
values.notes: Illusion. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S.

entries.label: Wind Walk
entries.summary: You and up to ten willing creatures you can see within range assume a gaseous form for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud. While in this cloud form, a creature has a flying speed of 300 feet and has resistance to damage from nonmagical weapons.

values.name: Wind Walk
values.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: 1 minute. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 8 hours. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Wind Wall
entries.summary: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration.

values.name: Wind Wall
values.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: 120 feet. Duration: 1 minute. Components: V, S, M.

entries.label: Wish
entries.summary: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality in accord with your desires. The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of 8th level or lower.

values.name: Wish
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Word of Recall
entries.summary: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below).

values.name: Word of Recall
values.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: 5 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V.

entries.label: Zone of Truth
entries.summary: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw.

values.name: Zone of Truth
values.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 60 feet. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.
